title: Practice 4: при- and у-: arriving, and leaving

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Tom doesn't seem to be leaving.
exercises.why: **уходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of уходить: imperfective (perfective partner: уйти).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: We bring it from Switzerland.
exercises.why: **привозим** — present tense (1st person plural) of привозить: imperfective (perfective partner: привезти).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
